svg.title: Before vs After InfoNCE contrastive embedding geometry
svg.desc: Architecture delta comparing untrained lexical vectors with overlapping positive and negative cosines against an InfoNCE-trained projection head in JAX that aligns positive support pairs to 100% Recall@1.
svg.text: REMOVED · noiseSuppress surface word-hash collisions across classes
ADDED · infonceSymmetric InfoNCE loss (τ = 0.08) + class alignment
REWIRED · r2Route normalized embeddings into InfoNCE softmax
REMOVED · r3Eliminate uncalibrated near-zero cosine margin
ADDED · r4Separate positive vs negative pairs on unit sphere
